verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Marketing Emails API lets an agent create and update marketing emails, and HubSpot's campaign agent can plan a campaign. The email editor documents segment targeting and scheduled sends, so a programmatically created email can sit unsent until a human schedules or sends it. However, nothing documents an explicit approval-before-send queue, or setting segments and schedules through the API. missing for 10: documented human approval/review gate before send, API-level segment assignment and scheduling, hands-on corroboration of an agent-drafted-then-approved flow

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
You can set contacts and segments who will receive the email
You can send a marketing email immediately or schedule the email to send at a specific date and time.
Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
